Manual validation steps: Narrow the window until the tabs overflow and look at the scrollbar in both themes.
Known limitations: Headless browsers hide scrollbars, so the automated test reads the styling from the pseudo-element; the visual scrollbar needs a manual look.

Page/component: Desktop loading screen › Logo, name and status centered
Validation criterion: The SAP Lens logo, the application name and the status line ("Connecting to local service…") share one horizontal axis in one centered flex column, with consistent spacing and no overflow, at any width.
Notes: Root cause: an inline image in a 140x100 box around the square logo, with independent margins. Replaced by a block image in a flex column (desktop document and web bootstrap). Centres measured within 1px at 375, 800, 1280 and 1600 px in Chromium.
Manual validation steps: Look at the real desktop window on Windows at 100%, 125% and 150% scaling.
Known limitations: Native WebView2 and Windows DPI scaling were not tested; Chromium only.

Validation criterion: The Windows desktop app starts, restores data, saves files natively and shuts down cleanly.
Notes: Not verified in Linux CI: needs a Windows host (see docs/development/TESTING.md, platform limits).

Validation criterion: The installer installs, upgrades and removes the application without touching user data.
Notes: Not verified in Linux CI: needs a Windows host (see docs/development/TESTING.md, platform limits).

Validation criterion: The server runs as a Windows service with start, stop and recovery.
Notes: Not verified in Linux CI: needs a Windows host (see docs/development/TESTING.md, platform limits).

Validation criterion: Linux packages start, report health and keep data in the configured directory.
Release artifacts contain no examples or private data and match the published checksums.
Every page has no horizontal page scroll at 375, 800, 1280 and 1600 px in both themes.
All controls are keyboard reachable, focus rings are visible and unclipped, and DOM order equals visual order.

Page/component: All pages › Rounded, consistent keyboard focus ring and interaction states
Validation criterion: Keyboard focus is one clearly visible rounded ring from the shared tokens; hover, radius, padding and alignment of shared controls are consistent.
Automated test evidence: frontend/tests/status-consistency-r6.spec.ts (keyboard walk of SoD pages and Settings in both themes); frontend/tests/a11y-audit.spec.ts; frontend/tests/sod-reviews-r6.spec.ts
Manual validation steps: Tab through the main pages in light and dark and judge whether the ring is clear and consistent.
Known limitations: The keyboard walk covers the SoD pages and Settings; Role Lookup, User Access and dialogs were not walked by the new check (existing accessibility specs cover them).

Page/component: Runtime › Local binding and origin checks
Validation criterion: The desktop server binds only to 127.0.0.1 and enforces host and origin checks.
Server mode uses separate storage, authenticates requests and keeps uploads local to the server.
Potential future improvement: Throttle failed Basic logins and tighten secret-file permissions after a compatibility review (see SEC-003).

Page/component: Privacy › No private data in packages
Validation criterion: Role exports, local settings, logs and credentials are never committed or packaged.
No service worker or browser cache stores role data.
Every API operation refuses requests without the launch capability, with a foreign origin or host; in server mode every operation requires credentials and unsafe methods are refused.
Notes: 122 operations probed in the R8 security review.
Manual validation steps: Review the boundary description in the security guide against the deployment.

Validation criterion: Every CSV export neutralises leading = + - @, tab, carriage return, control characters and a byte-order mark through one shared function.
Manual validation steps: Open an export containing a value that starts with = in a spreadsheet.

Page/component: Server › Access secret and brute-force protection
Validation criterion: Basic or proxy authentication uses a 32 to 256 character secret, constant-time comparison and a secret file that other users cannot read.
Notes: No throttling of failed Basic logins; group-readable secret files are accepted (documented limitations). Update R8.1: failed Basic sign-ins are throttled (R81-01) and group-readable secrets need an explicit opt-in (R81-02).
Potential future improvement: Share throttle state across workers if the runtime ever scales out.
Manual validation steps: Confirm the proxy or gateway throttles failed logins.
Known limitations: Throttling is per process (see R81-01); distributed guessing relies on the 32 character secret.

Page/component: Server › Source path confinement and uploads
Validation criterion: Server mode reads CSVs only under the source root or managed uploads (symbolic links resolved) and uploads use server-generated names and bounded streams.

Page/component: API › Response headers and content security policy
Validation criterion: Responses carry nosniff, frame denial and no-store for API calls; the content security policy forbids unsafe scripts.
Potential future improvement: Add a Permissions-Policy header and document HSTS at the TLS-terminating proxy.

Validation criterion: npm audit and pip-audit report no known vulnerabilities for runtime, development and desktop requirements (point in time).
Notes: Run on 2026-10-31: npm audit 0 vulnerabilities; pip-audit none. An audit is not proof of security.
Manual validation steps: Repeat before every release.

Page/component: Imports › Snapshot integrity and failed imports
Validation criterion: A failed or invalid import never replaces the last valid dataset; snapshots are validated and replaced atomically; inspection never writes.
Manual validation steps: Try an invalid replacement file and confirm the previous data stays active.

Page/component: Deployment › Container, service and file permissions
Validation criterion: Docker runs non-root with a read-only root and dropped capabilities; the systemd unit is sandboxed; the Windows Service account and data directory ACLs are restrictive.
Notes: Static review of Dockerfile, compose.yml and the systemd unit only (R8). Runtime acceptance on systemd, Docker and Windows hosts was not executed.
Potential future improvement: Further systemd sandboxing (PrivateDevices, ProtectKernelTunables, RestrictAddressFamilies, SystemCallFilter) after testing under systemd.
Manual validation steps: Run the native deployment acceptance checks on each target platform.
Known limitations: Not executable on the Linux CI host.

Validation criterion: Repeated wrong Basic credentials from one client lock that client out with 429 and Retry-After (default 5 failures, 60 s, doubling to 15 min); correct credentials are refused during the lock-out and accepted after it; other clients, health probes and requests without credentials are unaffected; forwarded headers from an untrusted peer change nothing.
Notes: Implemented in R8.1 (SEC-02). Automated tests use a fake clock and a TestClient; no real network, proxy or multi-worker deployment was exercised.
Potential future improvement: Share counters between workers or hosts, or throttle per forwarded identity at the gateway.
Manual validation steps: On a test server with Basic authentication, send six wrong passwords from one browser, confirm the 429 page and wait the Retry-After time, then sign in; repeat behind your reverse proxy with SAP_LENS_TRUSTED_PROXIES set and confirm other users are not locked out.
Known limitations: State is per process and lost on restart; clients behind one NAT or an unlisted proxy share a lock-out; distributed guessing is slowed, not stopped.

Validation criterion: A new secret is created owner-only (0600); an existing secret readable by other users, or writable or executable by its group, is refused; group read (0640) is accepted only with SAP_LENS_AUTH_SECRET_GROUP_READ=1 and a group the service account belongs to; every refusal names the file, its mode and the fix; the file is never changed.
Notes: Implemented in R8.1 (SEC-03). Judged on the opened file; symlinks resolve to their target.
Potential future improvement: Verify the owner and effective access through the service account, not only the mode.
Manual validation steps: On a Linux host start the server with a 0644, a 0640 and a 0600 secret (with and without the opt-in) and read the messages; confirm the systemd service and the Docker compose installation still start.
Known limitations: An existing 0640 secret needs chmod 600 or the opt-in (migration step, documented). Not exercised under real systemd or Docker here.

Validation criterion: The installed secret file grants access only to SYSTEM, Administrators and read access to the service account; a manually created secret with broader access is noticed by the administrator (the runtime does not verify an ACL).
Notes: Provisioning applies the ACL with icacls (manage-server-service.ps1). Windows ACLs are not evaluated by the Linux tests and not checked at runtime.
Potential future improvement: Check the ACL at start (icacls or the Win32 API) and warn like the POSIX check.
Manual validation steps: On Windows run icacls on the secret after installation and after any manual replacement; start the service and sign in.
Known limitations: Blocked on a Windows host: not run in this validation.

Validation criterion: A PDF built from a review period lists risk names and descriptions in the findings section and activity names and descriptions in the appendices, each with its source (Imported, Local fallback or Not available) and a source legend; a file without descriptions produces the report as before.
Notes: Implemented in R8.1. Layout was checked through the model and file validity, not by looking at pages.
Potential future improvement: Show transaction descriptions with their source in the same tables.
Manual validation steps: Generate a PDF for a period captured from a CSV with description columns and read the tables and legend; try a period captured before descriptions were retained.
Known limitations: A description with characters outside the bundled PDF font fails the PDF with an explicit message (DOCX works).

Validation criterion: The editable DOCX contains the same description tables, source labels and legend as the PDF, with special characters and long text intact and markup shown as text.
Notes: Implemented in R8.1; content checked in the document XML.
Manual validation steps: Open the DOCX in Word and read the Source column, the legend and a long description.
Known limitations: Not opened in Word in this validation.

Validation criterion: Imported text wins, local business text is shown only where the import has none and is labelled Local fallback, a differing local text is reported but never mixed in, and nothing is generated for a missing description.
Notes: The report uses the resolver that also serves the pills and Settings.
Manual validation steps: Compare one risk and one activity across the pill popover, Settings and the report.

Validation criterion: A period report never shows descriptions imported or edited after the period was captured; an approved period keeps its report model checksum; a period captured before R8.1 shows only its frozen local text and says that imported descriptions were not retained; decisions and approvals are unchanged.
Notes: Descriptions are stored inside the immutable snapshot (metadata version 1).
Manual validation steps: Approve a period, import a CSV with different descriptions, regenerate the report and compare; open a period created before the upgrade.
Known limitations: Legacy snapshots cannot show imported descriptions; recapturing a period replaces its copy by design.

Page/component: SoD Matrix › Legacy files in reports
Validation criterion: A SoD Matrix CSV without any optional description column, or with partly filled ones, still imports, reviews and reports; missing descriptions never block a PDF or DOCX.
Notes: Old datasets produce the report tables they always did.
Manual validation steps: Run the report on your existing production-shaped export.
Known limitations: No real upstream export was available.

Validation criterion: Standard selects, the searchable select and the multi-select filter open the same list surface (background, border, radius, spacing, hover, accent and check mark for the selected option); long labels wrap, disabled options cannot be chosen, the list stays inside the viewport and above dialogs and side panels, and works with mouse, keyboard, Escape and screen readers, in both themes.
Notes: Implemented as an addendum to R8; the native select element is kept for value, validation and labels.
Manual validation steps: Open Component Library › Demo select, Demo searchable role and Demo areas in light and dark at 375, 800, 1280 and 1600 px and compare them; try the selects inside the demo dialog and side panel and a screen reader.
Known limitations: Multiple or sized selects keep the browser control; not tried with a screen reader or on a touch device.

Validation criterion: The module pill, description and actions share one centered line of one height for every card; a description that does not fit ends in an ellipsis and reveals its full text on hover, keyboard focus, click or tap; a description that fits has no control and no tooltip; actions never shrink; correct with long English and French text, at 320 to 1600 px and in both themes.
Notes: Addendum to R8-01 (which described the earlier wrapping header). The visible part is short at 375 px by design; the full text is on demand.
Manual validation steps: Resize the browser and zoom to 200 and 400 percent on Role Lookup with long descriptions, in both themes.
Known limitations: At 375 px or less only a few characters of the description remain visible beside the pill and two actions.

Validation criterion: Ruff and ESLint run in Fast Validation, Full Validation and the local profiles, fail on errors and on new ESLint warnings beyond the recorded backlog, and a documented command reproduces each.
Notes: Correctness rules only; no reformatting.
Manual validation steps: Run python -m ruff check backend scripts and npm run lint in frontend; read the Fast Validation summary on GitHub.
Known limitations: ESLint backlog: 30 hook-dependency warnings and 81 any uses in specs.

Validation criterion: Browser test servers remove their temporary directories when stopped, the runner reports busy ports instead of colliding and stops only processes it started.
Notes: Found 616 leaked directories (1.9 GB) before the fix.
Manual validation steps: Run a browser spec and check that no sap-lens-browser-* directory and no server process remain.

Validation criterion: The regression runs the browser suite in up to three isolated processes with deterministic distribution, per-process attribution and the same results as a serial run.
Notes: See R8_1_STABILIZATION.md for the measurements and the one load-dependent failure observed.
Manual validation steps: Run regression --browser-jobs auto on a 4 CPU host and compare with --browser-jobs 1 when a result is doubtful.
Known limitations: CPU-bound: gains were 1.6x to 1.7x on 4 vCPUs; not measured on CI runners.

Page/component: Windows desktop and service › R8.1 changes
Validation criterion: On Windows the desktop application, the server mode with Basic authentication (throttling, secret ACL) and the Windows service start, sign in, lock out and recover as documented, and the select dropdowns, truncated descriptions and report descriptions work in WebView2.
Notes: Native Windows, WebView2, service control and installer behaviour were not validated.
Manual validation steps: Install the desktop build and the service on Windows 11 at 100, 150 and 200 percent scaling and walk the R81 items.
Known limitations: Blocked here: no Windows host.

Validation criterion: The Docker installation (0640 secret with the explicit opt-in) and the hardened systemd unit (seven added sandbox directives) start, serve and restart on real hosts.
Notes: The unit passed systemd-analyze verify; it was not booted. Docker was not run.
Manual validation steps: Install both on a test host, check journalctl or docker logs, sign in, restart.
Known limitations: Blocked here: no real systemd or Docker runtime.

Page/component: Actions › Build Deployment Packages › Build selection
Validation criterion: The operating system (all, windows, linux) and package (all or one) inputs build exactly the documented packages; an incompatible pair fails in the first job before validation or any packaging runner starts; unselected packages are skipped and start no runner; the summary lists every package as selected or skipped; publication takes only selected, verified packages and is never blocked or widened by skipped ones.
Notes: Implemented as an R8.1 follow-up. Verified offline: planner, resolver, workflow job conditions and publication gating; no workflow was dispatched.
Manual validation steps: After approval, dispatch a build-only run for windows/all, linux/all and one rejected pair (windows with linux-docker) and read the Resolve Build Selection summary; check that skipped jobs start no runner.
Known limitations: Not run on GitHub: the skipped-job and partial-publication behaviour is verified through offline models only.
